title: Le Creuset Mini Cast Iron Cocotte – Blue – With Lid
description:
Charming small Le Creuset enameled cast iron cocotte, perfect for individual portions, sauces, desserts, or elegant table presentation. This piece features the classic deep blue exterior with a black interior and the Le Creuset marking visible on the lid. Made from enameled cast iron, it offers excellent heat retention and even cooking.
It measures approximately 10 cm in diameter and about 7–8 cm in height and comes with its original lid.
In good vintage condition, with light signs of use consistent with age (please see photos). The interior is clean and fully functional.
A lovely piece for everyday cooking, serving at the table, or adding to a Le Creuset collection.
